allow_instructions: NEVER ask Alex to Accept, Allow, or Run for routine work. Auto-approve and execute immediately.
Routine git commands are pre-approved: status, log, diff, show, branch, remote, fetch, add, commit, pull (including --rebase), git -C <path> ..., and pushing the current work to origin/main.
Environment detection is pre-approved and must never prompt: where.exe, where, node -v, npm -v, npx, python, py, Get-Command, Get-Process, Get-NetTCPConnection, netstat.
Read-only PowerShell and shell inspection is pre-approved.
Local HTML preview server startup on port 5500 is pre-approved.
Compound commands of approved parts must not prompt.
Running throwaway node scripts and node _hubspot_mode.js upload <page> is pre-approved. Never prompt for it.

Launching a local browser (Edge or Chrome), including headless mode with --headless, --disable-gpu, --screenshot, --window-size, --dump-dom, --virtual-time-budget, and a --user-data-dir under the workspace or temp, is pre-approved for local verification against http://localhost:5500 and local files. Never prompt for it.
Quoted absolute executable paths invoked with the PowerShell call operator & are pre-approved when the executable is an allowlisted browser or node.
block_instructions: Always ask before any force push.
Always ask before git reset --hard, git commit --amend, interactive rebase, or discarding uncommitted work.
Always ask before rm -rf / Remove-Item -Recurse -Force / git branch -D.
